assets.title: Fashion student studio welcome visual
assets.description: An adult Fashion Design student in a calm studio-classroom space with a sketchbook, fabric, and a simple work table.
assets.notes: Use as a reading and listening support visual. Do not generate in Phase 2.

assets.title: Sketchbook vocabulary image
assets.description: A clear fashion sketchbook or croquis page suitable for A2 vocabulary recognition.
assets.notes: This image should be simple enough for matching and sentence-frame practice.

assets.title: Fabric swatch vocabulary image
assets.description: A close, readable fabric swatch image with visible textile texture and no distracting background.
assets.notes: Use for matching and phrase practice in the vocabulary starter.

assets.title: Garment vocabulary image
assets.description: A simple garment presented on a hanger or mannequin for beginner visual recognition.
assets.notes: Keep the garment easy to identify without advanced detail language.

assets.title: Sewing vocabulary image
assets.description: A sewing machine or hand-sewing scene that clearly represents sewing as a class area.
assets.notes: Avoid clutter so the image supports quick recognition.

assets.title: Patternmaking vocabulary image
assets.description: A simple patternmaking scene with paper pattern pieces, ruler, and measuring tools.
assets.notes: The image should visually distinguish patternmaking from sewing.

assets.title: Portfolio board vocabulary image
assets.description: A beginner-friendly portfolio board or page showing fashion work samples without readable brand text.
assets.notes: Use as a visual bridge between vocabulary and the profile-writing goal.

assets.title: First-week student introduction audio
assets.description: A short first-person introduction from a first-semester Fashion Design student that mentions classes, interests, and English goals.
assets.notes: Teacher read-aloud can substitute until audio is generated.
